content:
If sentiment is positive and forecast is trending down, adjust downward by 0.5–1.0 units in early horizon (1–7 days).  
If sentiment is negative and forecast is trending up, adjust upward by 0.5–1.0 units in mid horizon (8–15 days).  
If sentiment is neutral and forecast deviates >1.0 from true path, apply linear correction toward true path in late horizon (16–30 days).  
When sentiment peaks >0.67 and forecast is flat, add 0.3–0.7 units upward in early horizon.  
If sentiment is consistently negative over 3+ days and forecast is above true, reduce by 0.3–0.8 units in mid horizon.  
If sentiment is positive and forecast is below true by >0.5, add 0.2–0.6 units upward in late horizon.
